senses.en: done or given before something happens
senses.pattern: advance notice / advance warning / advance booking / advance tickets
senses.example: [[Advance]] booking is required for all guided tours of the palace, especially during the summer holidays.
senses.example_zh: 參加皇宮的所有導覽行程都必須事先預約，暑假期間尤其如此。

senses.en: to put forward an idea or theory for discussion
senses.pattern: advance a theory / advance an argument / advance a proposal
senses.example: The professor [[advanced]] a new theory to explain why the ancient city was suddenly abandoned.
senses.example_zh: 教授提出了一個新理論，來解釋這座古城為何突然遭到遺棄。

senses.en: to put or spread a substance on a surface
senses.pattern: apply sunscreen / apply ointment to a wound / apply a coat of paint
senses.example: Remember to [[apply]] sunscreen to your face and arms twenty minutes before going outdoors.
senses.example_zh: 記得在出門前二十分鐘，把防曬乳塗在臉和手臂上。

senses.en: to be relevant to or have an effect on
senses.pattern: apply to everyone / the rule applies / does not apply to
senses.example: The discount does not [[apply]] to items that are already on sale.
senses.example_zh: 這項折扣不適用於已經在特價的商品。

gsat.sentence: In winter, our skin tends to become dry and itchy, a problem which is usually treated by [[applying]] lotions or creams.

senses.en: difficult to deal with; causing problems
senses.pattern: an awkward job / an awkward question / an awkward customer
senses.example: Fixing the leak was an [[awkward]] job because the pipe was hidden behind the kitchen wall.
senses.example_zh: 修理漏水是件棘手的工作，因為水管藏在廚房的牆後面。

senses.en: not convenient; difficult to use or carry
senses.pattern: an awkward time / awkward to carry / an awkward shape
senses.example: Seven in the morning is an [[awkward]] time for a meeting, since most parents are taking children to school.
senses.example_zh: 早上七點開會是個不方便的時間，因為大多數家長正在送孩子上學。

gsat.sentence: The French were also slow to accept forks, for using them was thought to be [[awkward]].

senses.en: to improve something or make it better
senses.pattern: better the lives of / better oneself / better working conditions
senses.example: The charity works to [[better]] the lives of children growing up in remote mountain villages.
senses.example_zh: 這個慈善機構致力於改善偏遠山村孩童的生活。

senses.en: to do better than a previous result
senses.pattern: better a record / better one's score / cannot be bettered
senses.example: The young swimmer hopes to [[better]] her own national record at next month's championships.
senses.example_zh: 這位年輕泳將希望在下個月的錦標賽中超越自己保持的全國紀錄。

senses.en: a fault in a computer program or system
senses.pattern: a software bug / fix a bug / a bug in the system
senses.example: The game kept crashing until the developers found and fixed a [[bug]] in the code.
senses.example_zh: 這款遊戲一直當機，直到開發人員找到並修正程式碼裡的一個錯誤。

senses.en: to annoy or keep bothering someone
senses.pattern: stop bugging me / bug somebody about something / it bugs me that
senses.example: My little brother keeps [[bugging]] me to play with him while I am trying to study.
senses.example_zh: 我想讀書的時候，弟弟卻一直來煩我，要我陪他玩。

senses.en: a small room where a prisoner is kept
senses.pattern: a prison cell / a police cell / be locked in a cell
senses.example: The thief spent the night in a police [[cell]] before appearing in court the next morning.
senses.example_zh: 那名小偷在警局的牢房裡過了一夜，隔天早上才出庭。

senses.en: a device that produces electricity from chemicals or sunlight
senses.pattern: a solar cell / a fuel cell / a battery cell
senses.example: Solar [[cells]] on the roof turn sunlight into enough electricity to power the whole house.
senses.example_zh: 屋頂上的太陽能電池把陽光轉換成足以供應整棟房子的電力。

senses.en: having no record of crime or wrongdoing
senses.pattern: a clean record / a clean driving record
senses.example: Because he had a [[clean]] record, the judge let him off with only a warning.
senses.example_zh: 由於他紀錄清白，法官只給了警告就放過他。

senses.en: fair and following the rules
senses.pattern: a clean game / a clean fight / clean competition
senses.example: Both coaches praised the players for a [[clean]] game with no fouls or arguments.
senses.example_zh: 兩隊教練都稱讚球員打了一場守規則的比賽，沒有犯規也沒有爭執。

senses.en: an illness or medical problem, often not serious
senses.pattern: a skin complaint / a stomach complaint / a minor complaint
senses.example: The cream is used to treat eczema and other common skin [[complaints]] in young children.
senses.example_zh: 這種藥膏用於治療幼兒的濕疹及其他常見的皮膚疾病。

gsat.sentence: He frequently ordered blood tests and X-rays, and repeatedly referred her to specialists for even minor [[complaints]].
Most physician office visits are for stress-related illnesses and [[complaints]].

senses.en: to formally oppose or argue against a decision
senses.pattern: contest a decision / contest a will / contest a fine
senses.example: The driver decided to [[contest]] the parking fine because the sign had been hidden by a tree.
senses.example_zh: 那位駕駛決定對違規停車的罰單提出異議，因為標誌被樹擋住了。

senses.en: to compete to win a position or prize
senses.pattern: contest an election / contest a seat / contest the title
senses.example: Eight teams from across the country will [[contest]] the national title in the final round.
senses.example_zh: 來自全國各地的八支隊伍將在決賽階段角逐全國冠軍。

senses.en: to defeat completely or stop by force
senses.pattern: crush an opponent / crush a rebellion / crush the opposition
senses.example: The home team [[crushed]] their rivals by eight goals and moved easily into the final.
senses.example_zh: 地主隊以八球之差徹底擊敗對手，輕鬆晉級決賽。

senses.en: to make someone feel extremely upset or disappointed
senses.pattern: be crushed by the news / crush somebody's hopes / crush somebody's spirit
senses.example: Mia was [[crushed]] when she learned that she had not been chosen for the school band.
senses.example_zh: 米亞得知自己沒被選進學校樂隊時，感到極度沮喪。

senses.en: to tell or show someone the way
senses.pattern: direct somebody to the station / direct visitors to the exit / direct ships into port
senses.example: A kind shop owner [[directed]] the lost tourists to the nearest subway station.
senses.example_zh: 一位好心的店老闆為迷路的觀光客指路，告訴他們最近的捷運站怎麼走。

senses.en: to aim something at a particular person or thing
senses.pattern: direct criticism at / direct attention to / be directed at
senses.example: Most of the criticism was [[directed]] at the manager rather than at the players.
senses.example_zh: 大部分的批評是針對經理，而不是球員。

gsat.sentence: The pilot is needed to [[direct]] large ships into a port, where there are often deep water channels surrounded by shallower seabeds.

senses.en: to sell goods abroad at unfairly low prices
senses.pattern: dump goods on the market / dump cheap steel / be accused of dumping
senses.example: Local farmers complained that foreign companies were [[dumping]] cheap rice on the market.
senses.example_zh: 當地農民抱怨外國公司在市場上傾銷廉價的米。

senses.en: to suddenly end a relationship with someone
senses.pattern: dump one's boyfriend / get dumped / dump somebody for someone else
senses.example: He felt terrible after his girlfriend [[dumped]] him by text message just before the holidays.
senses.example_zh: 女友在假期前用簡訊甩掉他，讓他難過極了。

senses.en: to find out or prove that something is true
senses.pattern: establish the cause / establish the facts / establish that
senses.example: Doctors ran several tests to [[establish]] whether the infection had spread to her lungs.
senses.example_zh: 醫生做了幾項檢查，以查明感染是否已擴散到她的肺部。

senses.en: to make someone or something accepted in a position
senses.pattern: establish oneself as / establish a reputation / become established
senses.example: Her first novel [[established]] her as one of the most promising young writers in the country.
senses.example_zh: 她的第一本小說確立了她的地位，使她成為國內最有前途的年輕作家之一。

gsat.sentence: The expansion of European imperialism in the following centuries further [[established]] the “north up” practice as the standard.
He first [[established]] his reputation as an illustrator in his hometown of Boston.

senses.en: to want or like something
senses.pattern: fancy a drink / fancy a walk / fancy doing something
senses.example: Do you [[fancy]] a cup of tea, or would you rather have some juice?
senses.example_zh: 你想要喝杯茶，還是比較想喝點果汁？

senses.en: a sudden liking; something imagined, not real
senses.pattern: take a fancy to / a passing fancy / catch somebody's fancy
senses.example: The children took a [[fancy]] to the stray puppy and begged their parents to keep it.
senses.example_zh: 孩子們一下子就喜愛上那隻流浪小狗，央求父母把牠留下來。

senses.en: to suggest an idea for others to consider
senses.pattern: float an idea / float a proposal / float a plan
senses.example: At the meeting, one teacher [[floated]] the idea of starting classes an hour later.
senses.example_zh: 會議上，一位老師提出了晚一小時上課的想法。

senses.en: a decorated vehicle in a parade
senses.pattern: a parade float / a carnival float / decorate a float
senses.example: Each class decorated a [[float]] with flowers and balloons for the school's anniversary parade.
senses.example_zh: 每個班級都用鮮花和氣球裝飾一輛花車，參加校慶遊行。

senses.en: strange, odd, or hard to explain
senses.pattern: a funny smell / a funny noise / something funny going on
senses.example: There is a [[funny]] smell coming from the fridge; I think the milk has gone bad.
senses.example_zh: 冰箱傳出一股奇怪的味道，我想牛奶壞掉了。

senses.en: slightly ill or unwell
senses.pattern: feel funny / feel a bit funny / my stomach feels funny
senses.example: I felt a bit [[funny]] after the boat ride, so I sat down and drank some water.
senses.example_zh: 搭完船後我覺得有點不太舒服，所以坐下來喝了些水。

senses.en: the central or most important part
senses.pattern: the heart of the city / the heart of the matter / at the heart of
senses.example: Trust lies at the [[heart]] of every good friendship, and it takes years to build.
senses.example_zh: 信任是每段良好友誼的核心，而且需要多年才能建立。

senses.en: courage, hope, or enthusiasm
senses.pattern: lose heart / take heart / put one's heart into
senses.example: Do not lose [[heart]] after one bad exam; you still have plenty of time to improve.
senses.example_zh: 別因為一次考試考差就失去信心，你還有很多時間可以進步。

gsat.sentence: Located at the [[heart]] of Paris, this medieval cathedral is noted for its intricate architecture, stunning stained glass windows, and, above all, its bells.
They came from northwest England, the blackened [[heart]] of the Industrial Revolution: Its main street was “a dark, unattractive hole” and the river running through it was a string of dirty water.

senses.en: to move very slowly and carefully
senses.pattern: inch forward / inch along / inch toward the door
senses.example: The line was so long that we [[inched]] toward the ticket window for almost an hour.
senses.example_zh: 隊伍排得太長，我們朝售票窗口緩慢移動了將近一小時。

senses.en: the general situation in a particular field
senses.pattern: the political landscape / the media landscape / change the landscape of
senses.example: Online shopping has completely changed the retail [[landscape]] over the past twenty years.
senses.example_zh: 過去二十年來，網路購物徹底改變了零售業的局面。

senses.en: to improve land by planting and shaping it
senses.pattern: landscape a garden / landscape the grounds / beautifully landscaped
senses.example: The school hired a designer to [[landscape]] the empty yard with trees and a small pond.
senses.example_zh: 學校請了一位設計師為空蕩蕩的庭院造景，種上樹木並設了一座小池塘。

senses.en: to try to persuade officials to support something
senses.pattern: lobby the government / lobby for a change / lobby against a plan
senses.example: Parents' groups have been [[lobbying]] the city council for safer crossings near schools.
senses.example_zh: 家長團體一直在遊說市議會，要求在學校附近設置更安全的行人穿越道。

senses.en: a group that tries to influence lawmakers
senses.pattern: the environmental lobby / a powerful lobby / the farm lobby
senses.example: The environmental [[lobby]] is pushing for stricter limits on plastic packaging.
senses.example_zh: 環保遊說團體正在推動對塑膠包裝設下更嚴格的限制。

senses.en: unkind to others; unwilling to spend money
senses.pattern: be mean to somebody / a mean trick / mean with money
senses.example: It was [[mean]] of you to laugh at him when he dropped his lunch tray.
senses.example_zh: 他把午餐托盤打翻時你還笑他，真是太刻薄了。

senses.en: to intend something; to design for a purpose
senses.pattern: mean to do something / be meant to / be meant for
senses.example: I didn't [[mean]] to wake you; I was only looking for my keys.
senses.example_zh: 我不是有意要吵醒你，我只是在找鑰匙。
senses.note: be meant to 表「目的是、應該」

senses.en: the average of a set of numbers
senses.pattern: calculate the mean / the mean of the scores / above the mean
senses.example: To find the [[mean]], add up all the scores and divide by the number of students.
senses.example_zh: 要算出平均數，就把所有分數加起來，再除以學生人數。

gsat.sentence: The new manager is a real gentleman. He is kind and humble, totally different from the former manager, who was [[mean]] and bossy.
It is [[meant]] to be an enjoyable dining experience that can span hours.

senses.en: to grow or spread very quickly
senses.pattern: mushroom into / mushroom overnight / the number has mushroomed
senses.example: Coffee shops have [[mushroomed]] around the university since the new subway line opened.
senses.example_zh: 新的捷運線通車後，大學周邊的咖啡店大量湧現。

senses.en: control of a place by a foreign army
senses.pattern: military occupation / under occupation / the occupation of the city
senses.example: During the [[occupation]], many families hid their food from the foreign soldiers.
senses.example_zh: 佔領期間，許多家庭把糧食藏起來，不讓外國士兵發現。

senses.en: the act of living in or using a place
senses.pattern: ready for occupation / the occupation of the building / in occupation
senses.example: The new dormitory will be ready for [[occupation]] by the start of the autumn term.
senses.example_zh: 新宿舍將在秋季學期開始前準備就緒，可供學生居住。

senses.en: to have something because of someone's help
senses.pattern: owe one's success to / owe one's life to / owe it all to
senses.example: The singer says she [[owes]] her career to a teacher who encouraged her to keep practicing.
senses.example_zh: 這位歌手說，她把自己的歌唱事業歸功於一位鼓勵她持續練習的老師。

senses.en: to have a duty to give someone something
senses.pattern: owe somebody an apology / owe somebody an explanation / owe somebody a favor
senses.example: You [[owe]] your sister an apology for reading her diary without permission.
senses.example_zh: 你未經允許就看妹妹的日記，應該給她一個道歉。

gsat.sentence: The young man [[owes]] his success to many people, his parents in particular.

senses.en: a famous person, especially in entertainment or sport
senses.pattern: a TV personality / a sports personality / a radio personality
senses.example: A well-known television [[personality]] was invited to host the school's charity concert.
senses.example_zh: 一位大家熟悉的電視名人受邀主持學校的慈善音樂會。

senses.en: of or for ordinary people in general
senses.pattern: popular culture / popular support / popular opinion
senses.example: The plan to close the library was dropped because it had little [[popular]] support.
senses.example_zh: 關閉圖書館的計畫因為幾乎得不到民眾的支持而作罷。

senses.en: (of a belief) shared by many people
senses.pattern: popular belief / a popular misconception / contrary to popular belief
senses.example: Contrary to [[popular]] belief, bats are not blind and can actually see quite well.
senses.example_zh: 與普遍的看法相反，蝙蝠並不瞎，其實視力相當好。

gsat.sentence: Before Moran arrived, Yellowstone in the [[popular]] imagination was a harsh, wild place with hot water and steam coming out of hellish holes in the ground.

senses.en: to treat food or raw materials to change them
senses.pattern: processed food / process raw materials / highly processed
senses.example: The factory [[processes]] fresh milk into cheese and yogurt for local supermarkets.
senses.example_zh: 這家工廠把鮮奶加工成乳酪和優格，供應當地超市。

senses.en: to deal with data or documents by a set procedure
senses.pattern: process an application / process data / process an order
senses.example: It usually takes the office two weeks to [[process]] a passport application.
senses.example_zh: 那個辦事處通常要花兩週才能處理完一份護照申請。

gsat.sentence: They’re highly [[processed]] and contain no vegetables.
It replays the image back through the glasses after [[processing]] it on an attached computer.

senses.en: to mention something for discussion; to cause doubts
senses.pattern: raise a question / raise an issue / raise concerns / raise doubts
senses.example: Several students [[raised]] the issue of heavy homework at the meeting with the principal.
senses.example_zh: 幾位學生在與校長的會議上提出了作業太多的問題。

senses.en: to collect money for a particular purpose
senses.pattern: raise money / raise funds for charity / raise capital
senses.example: The club sold handmade cookies to [[raise]] money for the local animal shelter.
senses.example_zh: 社團販售手工餅乾，為當地的動物收容所籌募資金。

senses.en: an increase in the money you are paid
senses.pattern: get a raise / ask for a raise / a pay raise
senses.example: After two years of hard work, she finally asked her boss for a [[raise]].
senses.example_zh: 努力工作兩年後，她終於向老闆要求加薪。

gsat.sentence: Deadly shootings on US campuses have [[raised]] grave concerns about how to prevent such tragic incidents from happening again.
Amy succeeded in negotiating for a [[raise]] though her boss didn’t agree to increase her salary at first.

senses.en: a dead body; what is left of old buildings
senses.pattern: human remains / the remains of a temple / ancient remains
senses.example: Visitors can still see the [[remains]] of the old city wall behind the train station.
senses.example_zh: 遊客仍可在火車站後方看到舊城牆的遺跡。

senses.en: to still need to be done or dealt with
senses.pattern: it remains to be seen / much remains to be done / questions remain
senses.example: It [[remains]] to be seen whether the new rule will actually reduce traffic accidents.
senses.example_zh: 新規定是否真能減少交通事故，仍有待觀察。

gsat.sentence: Inside the burial box were the [[remains]] of the deceased.

senses.en: a noisy argument or serious disagreement
senses.pattern: have a row with / a family row / a row over
senses.example: The neighbors had a terrible [[row]] about the noise from last night's party.
senses.example_zh: 鄰居們為了昨晚派對的噪音發生了激烈的爭吵。

senses.en: to have a noisy argument
senses.pattern: row with somebody / row about money / row over
senses.example: The two brothers are always [[rowing]] about whose turn it is to wash the dishes.
senses.example_zh: 這對兄弟老是為了輪到誰洗碗而吵架。

senses.en: to be the time or place when something happens
senses.pattern: the year saw / the city has seen / see a rise in
senses.example: The past decade has [[seen]] a sharp rise in the number of people working from home.
senses.example_zh: 過去十年見證了居家工作人數的急遽增加。

senses.en: to make sure that something is done
senses.pattern: see that the door is locked / see to it that / see that everyone gets a copy
senses.example: Please [[see]] that all the windows are closed before you leave the classroom.
senses.example_zh: 離開教室前，請確保所有窗戶都已關好。
senses.note: 也作 see to it that …

senses.en: to accept a responsibility or burden
senses.pattern: shoulder the responsibility / shoulder the burden / shoulder the cost
senses.example: After her father fell ill, she had to [[shoulder]] the responsibility of running the family shop.
senses.example_zh: 父親生病後，她必須承擔起經營家中店鋪的責任。

senses.en: the edge of a road outside the traffic lanes
senses.pattern: the hard shoulder / pull over onto the shoulder / drive on the shoulder
senses.example: When the engine started smoking, he pulled over onto the [[shoulder]] and called for help.
senses.example_zh: 引擎開始冒煙時，他把車停到路肩並打電話求救。

gsat.sentence: They may fill out an agreement spelling out who [[shoulders]] which responsibilities if a problem arises.

senses.en: living in groups rather than alone
senses.pattern: social animals / social insects / highly social species
senses.example: Ants are [[social]] insects that live in large colonies and share the work of finding food.
senses.example_zh: 螞蟻是群居的昆蟲，生活在龐大的蟻群中，並分工覓食。

gsat.sentence: They are highly [[social]] birds and often travel in large flocks.

senses.en: a place where water flows up from the ground
senses.pattern: a hot spring / a mountain spring / spring water
senses.example: Hikers filled their bottles at a cold [[spring]] halfway up the mountain trail.
senses.example_zh: 登山客在山徑半途的一處冷泉把水壺裝滿。

senses.en: to appear suddenly; to jump quickly
senses.pattern: spring up / spring to mind / spring to one's feet
senses.example: Dozens of food stalls [[sprang]] up near the stadium as soon as the tournament was announced.
senses.example_zh: 錦標賽一宣布，體育場附近就突然出現了數十個小吃攤。

senses.en: a coiled piece of metal that returns to shape
senses.pattern: a metal spring / bed springs / a broken spring
senses.example: One of the [[springs]] in the old sofa had broken, so sitting on it was uncomfortable.
senses.example_zh: 舊沙發裡的一根彈簧斷了，所以坐起來很不舒服。

gsat.sentence: Since the 1970s, book towns like Hay-on-Wye have been [[springing]] up all over the world.
The Tuck family has discovered a [[spring]] whose water brings eternal life.

senses.zh: 一連串；源源不絕（的人或物）
senses.en: a continuous flow of people or things
senses.pattern: a steady stream of / a stream of visitors / a constant stream of questions
senses.example: The new museum has attracted a steady [[stream]] of visitors since it opened in June.
senses.example_zh: 新博物館自六月開幕以來，吸引了源源不絕的參觀者。

senses.en: to move or flow continuously in large numbers
senses.pattern: stream out of / stream into / stream down one's face
senses.example: When the final bell rang, hundreds of students [[streamed]] out of the school gates.
senses.example_zh: 最後一聲鐘響時，數百名學生從校門湧出。

senses.en: to look carefully at the whole of something
senses.pattern: survey the scene / survey the damage / survey the crowd
senses.example: From the top of the tower, we [[surveyed]] the whole valley spread out below us.
senses.example_zh: 我們從塔頂眺望在腳下展開的整座山谷。

senses.en: to measure and record the details of land
senses.pattern: survey the land / survey a site / survey the coastline
senses.example: Engineers [[surveyed]] the hillside carefully before deciding where the new bridge should be built.
senses.example_zh: 工程師仔細勘測了山坡，才決定新橋該建在哪裡。

gsat.sentence: Sullivan, while [[surveying]] a campground, felt that a cloud was coming after him, and tried all he could to run—but it got him anyway.

senses.en: finished doing or using something
senses.pattern: be through with something / be through with somebody / when you are through
senses.example: Could you pass me the dictionary when you are [[through]] with it?
senses.example_zh: 你用完那本字典後，可以遞給我嗎？
senses.note: 不放在名詞前，常接 with

senses.en: because of something
senses.pattern: through no fault of one's own / through carelessness / through lack of
senses.example: Hundreds of workers lost their jobs [[through]] no fault of their own when the factory closed.
senses.example_zh: 工廠關閉時，數百名工人失去了工作，卻不是由於他們自己的過錯。

senses.en: a test to see if something works well
senses.pattern: a clinical trial / a trial period / on trial / trial and error
senses.example: The new vaccine proved safe in a clinical [[trial]] involving three thousand volunteers.
senses.example_zh: 這款新疫苗在一項有三千名自願受試者參與的臨床試驗中證實是安全的。

senses.en: a difficult experience that tests your patience or strength
senses.pattern: the trials of life / trials and tribulations / a trial to somebody
senses.example: Looking after three noisy children all day was a real [[trial]] for the new babysitter.
senses.example_zh: 整天照顧三個吵鬧的孩子，對新來的保母是一大考驗。

gsat.sentence: If that works, human [[trials]] will be next on the agenda.

senses.en: the amount of space something fills or contains
senses.pattern: the volume of a cube / the volume of water / by volume
senses.example: To calculate the [[volume]] of the box, multiply its length, width, and height.
senses.example_zh: 要計算這個盒子的體積，把它的長、寬、高相乘即可。

senses.en: the amount of something, especially when large
senses.pattern: the volume of traffic / sales volume / a high volume of
senses.example: The [[volume]] of traffic on this highway doubles during the Lunar New Year holiday.
senses.example_zh: 春節假期期間，這條高速公路的車流量會增加一倍。

senses.en: one book in a series or set
senses.pattern: the first volume / volume two / a three-volume set
senses.example: The second [[volume]] of the novel picks up the story ten years after the first one ends.
senses.example_zh: 這部小說的第二冊從第一冊結束的十年後接續故事。

senses.en: to be the time or place of an event
senses.pattern: the century witnessed / witness great changes / witness rapid growth
senses.example: The last century [[witnessed]] remarkable progress in medicine and public health.
senses.example_zh: 上個世紀見證了醫學和公共衛生的非凡進步。

senses.en: evidence or proof that something is true
senses.pattern: bear witness to / be witness to / stand as witness to
senses.example: The ruined walls bear [[witness]] to the terrible flood that struck the town decades ago.
senses.example_zh: 殘破的牆壁見證了數十年前侵襲這座城鎮的可怕洪水。

gsat.sentence: The 1960s and ’70s [[witnessed]] the development of most modern stunt technology, like air rams and bullet squibs.

quiz.stem: Many people believe that wealthy countries should ______ a larger share of the burden of fighting climate change, since they have long been the biggest polluters.
quiz.explain_zh: shoulder＝承擔（責任）。富裕國家長期是最大污染源，應承擔更多對抗氣候變遷的責任。

quiz.stem: The doctor said that my grandfather's stomach ______ was not serious and could be treated with a change of diet and some rest.
quiz.explain_zh: complaint＝疾病、身體不適。爺爺的胃病不嚴重，調整飲食並休息即可治療。

quiz.stem: Since the city built bike lanes five years ago, the number of bicycle rental shops has ______ from just three to more than sixty.
quiz.explain_zh: mushroom＝迅速增長。自行車出租店五年內從三家暴增到六十多家。

quiz.stem: The washing machine has been making a ______ noise since this morning, so Mom turned it off and called someone to repair it.
quiz.explain_zh: funny＝奇怪的。洗衣機從早上就一直發出怪聲，媽媽把它關掉並找人來修理。

quiz.stem: Scientists digging in the desert discovered the ______ of a dinosaur that had lived more than seventy million years ago.
quiz.explain_zh: remain＝（複數 remains）遺骸。科學家在沙漠中挖到七千多萬年前的恐龍遺骸。

quiz.stem: The runner plans to ______ the judges' decision, insisting that the video clearly shows she crossed the finish line first.
quiz.explain_zh: contest＝對…提出異議。跑者堅稱影片顯示她先衝線，打算對裁判的判決提出異議。

quiz.stem: The airport opened a third terminal to handle the growing ______ of passengers, which had doubled in just ten years.
quiz.explain_zh: volume＝（數）量。機場啟用第三航廈，以應付十年內倍增的旅客量。

quiz.stem: The airline gave passengers no ______ notice of the cancellation, so hundreds of travelers were left waiting at the airport overnight.
quiz.explain_zh: advance＝事先的。航空公司未事先通知航班取消，數百名旅客只好在機場過夜。

quiz.stem: Because of an accident ahead, the cars on the highway could only ______ forward, and it took us two hours to travel five kilometers.
quiz.explain_zh: inch＝緩慢移動。前方發生事故，車輛只能緩慢前進，五公里開了兩小時。

quiz.stem: Firefighters have not yet been able to ______ the cause of the explosion, but they suspect that a gas leak was responsible.
quiz.explain_zh: establish＝查明、證實。消防人員尚未查明爆炸原因，但懷疑是瓦斯外洩。
